name: Wen-Shen
description: Make the most of her dueling power and her harrassing potential.

skills.name: Star of Ill Omen
skills.description: Jinxes the nearest enemy, disabling them for 4s while dealing DMG equal to 80% of ATK per sec.

upgrades.level3: Increases DMG per sec to 100% ATK.

skills.name: Duality Inversion
skills.description: Curses the symmetrically opposite enemy, dealing DMG equal to 50% of their max HP (up to 1000% of Wenshen’s ATK). The curse is slowly lifted over 5s, restoring the lost HP.

upgrades.level2: While cursed, the target receives 30% reduced healing.
upgrades.level3: The curse is slowly lifted over 8s, restoring the lost HP.
upgrades.level4: While cursed, the target receives 60% reduced healing.

skills.name: Calamity-Ridden
skills.description: The enemy defeating Wenshen becomes permanently Jinxed (Passive). Jinxed: Has a 50% chance to be stunned, terrified, or petrified for 2.5s when attacking; has a 50% chance to be knocked down when moving. Jinxed can only trigger once every 4s.

upgrades.level2: Enemies also take DMG equal to 50% of her ATK per sec.
upgrades.level4: Increases the chance of triggering a Jinxed effect to 60%.

skills.name: Cursed Ground
skills.description: Wenshen creates an Aura of Misfortune within a 3-meter radius around her, reducing the ATK of enemies inside by 20% (Passive). She flies toward the enemy with the highest ATK, dealing DMG equal to 180% of ATK (Active).

upgrades.level2: Enemies inside the Aura of Misfortune have their DEF reduced by 20%.
upgrades.level4: Wenshen’s Aura of Misfortune lingers on the spot when she is defeated.

relic.name: Origin of Pestilence
relic.description: When a Jinxed enemy is defeated, it spreads to 1 nearest enemy, dealing DMG equal to 200% of ATK to the new target.

upgrades.level2: Upon spreading, increases DMG to 260% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Enemies cursed by Duality Inversion are permanently Jinxed.
upgrades.level4: The target takes 20% increased DMG while Jinxed.
